_doc: Roads (roads.gd, sim.roads): a level for every 30-pace cell of the land (the foot-wear grid). Level 0 is open ground. A trail emerges by itself where people walk again and again (foot wear above emerge_wear) and fades after fade_days without enough feet (below keep_wear). Built levels come from the Road tool (or the Steward): needs (conditions), cost per cell (cheaper by trail_discount over an existing trail or road), work per cell; they never fade. speed: how much faster people walk on it. look: how the terrain shader paints it (1 worn dirt, 2 packed earth, 3 stone).

levels.name: Packed-earth road
levels.desc: Stamped earth with ditches at its sides: people walk a quarter faster.

levels.name: Stone road
levels.desc: Flat stones laid in packed earth: people walk 40% faster, in any weather.
